summary.headline: Interrogations, Runaways, and Twelve Places
summary.text: Catalog entries for folios 408–414v of a Neapolitan astrological codex, covering bodily parts under the planets, climes, interrogations, timing events, absent persons, venereal love, enemies, fugitives and runaways, concealment, star stations, spear-bearing, and the twelve places. Authorities and parallels include Masha'allah, Maximus, Protagoras of Nicaea, and cited Bononian, Venetian, and Parisian codices.
